scope: Fixed-iteration diagnostic of the R2 Bec losses. Timed sources and callback algorithms unchanged. Every diagnostic CPU-time case and every incomplete PMU case retained; original matching CPU-time cases retained.
interpretation: Original AVX2 random-encode loss reverses under fixed iteration/common argv0 in both ASLR modes, while each arm has exact linked prepare/encoding::make and scalar-encode function bytes and addresses across the two cohorts. The scalar encode body also matches across arms. Terminal-read losses mostly vanish. This weakens attribution to API work; it does not prove a universal gain or dismiss the original negative. Full caller/layout/predictor history remain possible influences.
limits: Diagnostic with fixed five million benchmark iterations and common argv[0], with ASLR control where available. Timed source is unchanged. Perf counts the entire user-space process, including startup/fixtures/framework; these are not exact loop instruction counts. Only events perf reports at 100.00% running are compared. Perf default scaling and reporting precision remain in its raw CSV; this reader applies no further scaling. Generic cache misses are diagnostic and do not establish a residency level. Benchmark timing and process counters remain separate; no pooled speedup or confidence interval is inferred.
